articles.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
articles.excerpt: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
articles.summary: NVIDIA 开源的 OpenShell 为自主 AI agent 提供安全、私密的运行时环境，将 agent 的执行过程限制在隔离沙箱内，避免其直接接触宿主系统与敏感数据。适合企业或本地部署中运行需要调用工具、执行命令的智能体，降低权限滥用与数据泄露风险。

articles.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
articles.excerpt: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
articles.summary: 全本地运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代方案，支持声音克隆与音色设计、视频配音、听写、转写和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。语音处理全部在本地完成，无需上传云端，适合注重隐私的创作者、播客与视频制作者自建语音工作流。

articles.title: mvschwarz/openrig
articles.excerpt: Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system
articles.summary: openrig 是一个多智能体编排框架，把 Claude Code 与 Codex 组合成同一个系统协同工作，让不同模型各自负责擅长的环节。适合希望同时利用多个编码 agent、在复杂任务上分工协作的开发者，可作为本地多 agent 工作流的调度层。

articles.title: mksglu/context-mode
articles.excerpt: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
articles.summary: 针对 AI 编码 agent 的上下文窗口优化工具：将工具输出沙箱化后可减少约 98% 的 token 占用，持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上统一路由。适合长时间运行的 coding agent 用户，缓解上下文膨胀与重复调用问题。

articles.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
articles.excerpt: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
articles.summary: ponytail 通过提示与规则让 AI 编码 agent 像「最懒的资深工程师」那样思考，优先选择不写代码或少写代码的方案，避免过度设计和臃肿实现。适合追求最小改动、希望 agent 克制生成冗余代码的开发者日常使用。

articles.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
articles.excerpt: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
articles.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo 借助大模型与自动化工作流，只需输入主题或关键词，就能一键生成高清短视频，自动完成文案、素材、配音和字幕等环节。适合自媒体运营者与短视频创作者批量生产内容，显著降低视频制作门槛。

articles.title: openclaw/openclaw
articles.excerpt: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
articles.summary: openclaw 定位为真正能做事、而非只聊天的 AI，宣称跨操作系统、跨平台运行，可自主执行实际任务。仓库描述信息有限，具体能力与实现方式需查阅项目文档，适合关注通用型自主 agent 的开发者跟进。

articles.title: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
articles.excerpt: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
articles.summary: ComposioHQ 维护的 Claude Skills 精选清单，汇总可用于定制 Claude 工作流的技能、资源与工具，方便开发者快速找到现成扩展。适合正在用 Claude 搭建自动化流程、希望复用社区技能的人按需查阅和选型。

articles.title: mattpocock/skills
articles.excerpt: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
articles.summary: mattpocock/skills 收录作者 .agents 目录中实际在用的技能集，面向一线工程师，强调解决真实开发问题而非演示效果。适合使用 Claude 等编码 agent 的开发者参考，快速为自己的 agent 配置一套可用技能。

articles.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
articles.excerpt: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
articles.summary: hyperframes 让你直接编写 HTML，再渲染成视频，专为 agent 场景设计。开发者可用熟悉的网页技术描述画面，由 agent 生成并输出视频文件，适合需要程序化、批量化产出视频内容的团队与个人。

articles.title: colbymchenry/codegraph

articles.title: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare AI Gateway now features a model router that evaluates request complexity using an edge-deployed classifier to select the optimal model. By balancing expected output quality against token costs, organizations can dramatically cut AI spend while maintaining performance.

articles.title: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent
articles.excerpt: You can now use built-in error monitoring in Cloudflare Workers to group production failures and send stack traces, logs, traces, and application context directly to a coding agent to investigate further and open a pull request.

articles.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Registrar’s new search delivers fast, transparent results across 420+ extensions using Workers, Durable Objects, and WebSockets. Its expanded API and cf CLI also let agents search, register, and transfer domains.

articles.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare’s AI Gateway, Ceramic.ai, Stocktwits, and more are using the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway today to charge agents for access to tokens, APIs, and MCP tools. U.S.-based sellers can now apply for access to the closed beta.

articles.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid
articles.excerpt: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use.

articles.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights
articles.excerpt: AI Gateway User Insights now adds task, model, turn, and user categories to help teams understand AI adoption and make better model decisions. This is available free to AI Gateway users.

articles.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Containers now start 6x faster, let your agent choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, and support filesystem snapshots in public beta, all controlled from a Durable Object.

articles.title: The Internet has a second audience
articles.excerpt: More than half the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated, and AI agents are the fastest-growing part of it. We're giving site owners the tools to see who's visiting, decide who gets in, and charge for access.

articles.title: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration
articles.excerpt: We’re building CryptoLabe, an internal AI-powered tool that discovers cryptography across our codebase, surfaces dependencies, and helps us progress toward a full post-quantum migration by 2029. Here’s what we’ve learned so far.

articles.title: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet
articles.excerpt: Twelve years after launching Universal SSL, Cloudflare is applying to become a certificate authority. By combining an established root, an ACME-first approach, and Merkle Tree Certificates, we are building a post-quantum CA for the open web.

articles.title: Adaptive application security for the AI era: how Cloudflare connects code, traffic, and intelligence to stop attacks
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare introduces an adaptive security framework connecting risk discovery, agent governance, runtime protection, and AI-powered response in a continuous learning loop.

articles.title: Building a post-quantum certificate authority with Merkle Tree Certificates
articles.excerpt: As post-quantum signatures threaten to inflate TLS handshakes and certificate transparency logs, Merkle Tree Certificates offer a path to compact, auditable authentication. Cloudflare’s new certificate authority will support MTC issuance at scale.

articles.title: We tested our own WAF with frontier AI models. Here’s what we found

articles.title: Is your domain using post-quantum encryption? Now you can see for yourself
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare has added visibility into post-quantum (PQ) encryption in TLS 1.3 directly into HTTP Analytics, Log Explorer, and Logpush. Learn how to make sure your domain is protected with PQ encryption.

articles.title: Enforce positive security with Cloudflare Application Profiles
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare learns the structure of your HTTP requests and identifies deviations. You can add a positive security layer that helps reduce attack surface as AI makes it easier for attackers to generate and vary payloads.

articles.title: Preventing quantum downgrade attacks against IPsec
articles.excerpt: A sophisticated attacker with a quantum computer can exploit a protocol design flaw to downgrade post-quantum IPsec tunnels to classical crypto. We helped the IETF develop a transcript authentication extension to prevent these attacks.

articles.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
